item.title: Latest flare-up between US and Iran bring conflict's lull to an end
item.description: Iran's foreign minister has accused Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu of tricking the United States into war with the Islamic Republic. Over six months into the conflict, there appears to be no end in sight. This after the US struck sites in Iran, prompting Tehran to respond. An April ceasefire brought an end to intense fighting, but sporadic attacks have continued over the Strait of Hormuz. item.title: Netanyahu's wife shares conspiracy claim that opposition leader knew of Oct 7 attacks in advance
item.description: As Israel prepares for what are expected to be close-fought parliamentary elections in October, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's wife Sara on Monday shared a conspiracy theory that centre-left opposition figure Yair Golan had advance warning of the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attacks.

item.title: Raising the Altalena: Netanyahu digs up sunken 1948 arms ship in ‘pre-election stunt’
item.description: A ship carrying arms for a right-wing militia, the Altalena was sunk 78 years ago off the coast of Tel Aviv at the orders of Israel’s founders. The discovery of its wreckage last week has given the country’s right-wing government ammunition to target the left and attempt to redirect the campaign for legislative elections in October.

item.title: Xi calls on Mideast nations to be ‘masters of their own affairs’ in rare Egypt visit
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping on Wednesday called on "the people of the Middle East" to oppose "externalinterference" and consider reshaping the region's security order during a visit to Egypt. The rare visit by the Chinese leader comes as Beijing aims to expand its influence in the region as the Iran war tests the reliability of the traditional US security umbrella in a vital geostrategic zone.

item.title: UNIFIL peacekeepers patrol south Lebanon, caught between Israel and Hezbollah
item.description: Since this spring, about 6 percent of Lebanon has been occupied by the Israeli army. On the ground, around 600 French soldiers from the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) continue to patrol the zone. The delicate peacekeeping mission documents violations of UN resolutions by both Israel and Hezbollah, with its own future highly uncertain. Our France 2 colleagues report, with FRANCE 24's Florent Marchais.

item.title: Relentless heat worsens Gaza's ongoing struggle to access water
item.description: In Gaza, securing drinking water is a relentless daily struggle. The war with Israel has destroyed critical water and sanitation infrastructure, and as temperatures soar, the extreme heat is escalating an already severe shortage into a deadly humanitarian crisis. Two and a half years of war with Israel have damaged or destroyed nearly 90% of Gaza’s water and sanitation infrastructure according to UNICEF.

item.title: Iran, US trade fire in first exchange in a month
item.description: Iran attacked US military targets in the Middle East on Monday in retaliation following American strikes on an island in the Strait of Hormuz, the first exchange of fire for a month in a war that has engulfed the region.

item.title: Middle East war flares up after Iran responds to US attacks
item.description: Iran attacked US military targets in the Middle East in retaliation for the first American strikes on its territory in a month. This signs a fresh flare-up of the war that has engulfed the region. Washington said its attacks were aimed at preventing Iran from placing more sea mines in the strait and as it threatens new secondary economic sanctions. FRANCE 24's Reza Sayah is in Tehran and tells us more.

item.title: Israel ‘organised and prepared’ to remove Gaza population if US gives green light, Katz
item.description: Israel is "organised and prepared" to remove Palestininians from Gaza "by every way possible", Defence Minister Israel Katz told reporters Wednesday, adding that there was no alternative "solution" to crisis. The Israeli government was simply waiting for the US to figure out where to take the displaced Gazans, he said.

item.title: US military striking targets in Iran after attempted attacks on shipping
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday suggested renaming the Strait of Hormuz as "Trump Strait" since it was under US "control". The vital waterway remains contested and Tehran has warned that the US faces a "new" war strategy after the heaviest exchange of attacks between the foes in weeks. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.
